cases.input: An authorized feature task requires: Select and integrate a coherent icon family using React Icons, Lucide or an existing library with accessible meaning, bounded imports and preserved upstream license information.
cases.expected: Inspect the actual stack, implement the bounded domain procedure, exercise its relevant acceptance flow and preserve untested boundaries.

cases.input: A toolbar imports every React Icons pack by namespace and exposes unlabeled icon-only buttons whose SVG titles disappear in the accessibility tree.
cases.expected: Use a finite family/registry, label the actionable elements, verify keyboard/accessible names and inspect the production bundle and family notices.
